subject: Request: incremental-streaming SLA exemption for Novapulse POC
messages:
From: Jake Turner <jake.turner@novapulse.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novapulse.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Streaming SLA details for POC — time-to-first / sustained tokens

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo this morning. We have a short POC (3 weeks) to validate live transcription for our courtroom ingestion flow. A couple of questions from engineering and procurement before we sign the POA:

- We are asking for a streaming SLA carveout for the POC. Specifically: what is Redwood's commitment on time-to-first-token (TTFT) for streaming endpoints versus non-streaming (sync) endpoints?
- We need guidance for expected sustained emission (tokens/sec) for long transcripts — our target is ~60 tokens/sec sustained for 95th percentile; is that realistic on shared capacity?
- If we hit outliers / stalls, will Redwood automatically fallback to a sync-mode variant or a smaller compressed model? How are those fallbacks governed?

I've attached a short list of questions procurement needs answered for the POA. Could you send a recommended carveout text we can include in the SOW? Procurement will also want an audit path for token metrics during the POC.

Thanks,
Jake Turner
Head of Product, Novapulse AI
Attachments: Novapulse-SLA-questions.pdf (pdf)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jake Turner <jake.turner@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@novapulse.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Streaming SLA details for POC — time-to-first / sustained tokens

Jake — thanks for the clear list. High level answer first, then a short carveout we can propose to procurement.

High level:
- Standard hosted streaming: we measure TTFT as the latency to the first emitted token from receipt of request. Our default SLO is p50 <= 300ms and p95 <= 650ms for streaming endpoints on our hosted tier for 2k token contexts. For sync endpoints we target end-to-end request completion latency (not applicable for long streaming outputs).
- Sustained emission: on shared pools we size for typical conversational workloads; for high sustained token/sec (>=50–60 TPS) we recommend a dedicated capacity reservation (Redwood Dedicated) or an autoscaled burst profile. On shared hosted pools, 60 tokens/sec sustained at 95th is likely above our SLAs without reserved capacity.
- Fallbacks: we support policy-based fallback to compatible model variants. For the POC we can configure automatic fallback to a smaller quantized variant (same model family) if we detect sustained backpressure for >10s, preserving connection and emitting a short system notice. We can also configure a canary path to route critical customers to Dedicated when available.

Proposed carveout language (editable for SOW):
"For the Novapulse Proof-of-Concept (POC), Redwood Inference will operate hosted streaming endpoints with the following temporary SLA carveouts: time-to-first-token (TTFT) p50 <= 350ms, p95 <= 800ms, measured from request receive to first token emitted. Sustained emission guidance: Redwood will aim to provide up to 50 tokens/sec sustained at p95 on hosted shared capacity; sustained rates above 50 tokens/sec should be supported via a Dedicated capacity reservation as defined in the attached capacity plan. In the event of sustained backpressure or resource contention (detected >10s), Redwood may transparently route traffic to a compatible, lower-latency model variant or Dedicated pool per mutually agreed fallback policies; such a fallback will be logged and visible to Novapulse in the Redwood Console. This POC carveout is limited to the active POC dates (YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD) and is subject to standard usage-based billing."

Next steps: I attached a draft Word doc with the carveout text plus a quick capacity suggestion. If procurement is happy, we can produce a DocuSign amendment (I can loop legal). Also: we can enable token emission telemetry and a short audit stream for the POC.

Would you like Karthik to map the Dedicated sizing and cost delta for the 3-week POC?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@novapulse.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Streaming SLA details for POC — time-to-first / sustained tokens

Quick note from infra/capacity:

Evelyn's carveout looks fine for a short POC. If Novapulse expects sustained 60 TPS at p95, we recommend the following options:

1) Dedicated short-term reservation: allocate a 2-GPU Dedicated pool (A100-class) for the 3-week POC. This supports sustained 60 tokens/sec at p95 for transcripts up to ~20k tokens before memory-pressure optimizations. We can provide a cost delta and a fast path for provisioning (48–72 hours).

2) Hosted + autoscale with burst policy: keep on hosted shared pools but enable explicit burst credit with a hard cap. This reduces cost but does not provide a hard SLA for sustained 60 TPS; it's best-effort with monitoring and fallback.

Audit/logging: we can provide a 1min resolution token emission log and a per-request trace id surfaced in the Console. Procurement: we will include a SOC2 pointer and can provide a redacted audit sample for the POA.

Attaching a quick capacity worksheet and sample deployment timeline. If you approve option 1, I'll prepare the provisioning ticket and cost breakout.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head of Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
Attachments: capacity-plan-novapulse.xlsx (xlsx)

Appreciate the quick responses. Procurement wants the carveout language integrated into the POA and will request a 48-hour provisioning lead if we go Dedicated. Two quick asks before we sign:

1) Can you add a sentence that fallback events are surfaced as an "SLA-fallback" event in the Console with the trace id? We need reliable detection for alerts.
2) Procurement will request a short SOC2 summary and a sample of the token emission log format (even redacted) to attach to the POA.

Assuming you can confirm the above, we'll move forward with a 2-GPU Dedicated POC reservation and sign the amendment. Please send the DocuSign when ready.

Thanks,
Jake Turner
Head of Product, Novapulse AI
